# The tables whose foreign key into `project` is ON DELETE CASCADE, one name per line — the only
# statement of this list. `core/tests/health_delta_migration.rs` compares it against the migrated
# schema's own cascading children, so a migration that adds one without appending its line here, in
# the same change, fails there.
#
# Direct children of `project` only. A table that cascades from one of these, never from `project`
# itself, is not listed: the comparison reads foreign keys into `project` and nothing else.
#
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are skipped. Concurrent additions merge by union.
project_committer
fts_commits
collection_member
project_job_state
art_scene
peek_cache
project_account
project_content_scan
debt_item
debt_sweep
project_dependency_scan
project_lockfile
project_dependency
advisory_notified
project_check
health_delta
parcel
removal_record
